title: A/R PDF prints the as-of date you picked, late in the day too
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has open invoices on today's date.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST REL-03 Evening Print.
  • The test is run in the evening, after 7 pm your local time, when the date in UTC is already tomorrow.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Finance > A/R Detail is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Check that the date chip shows today's date.
  2. Choose "Download (PDF)" from the ⋯ menu.
  3. Read the as-of line of the PDF.
  4. Compare the PDF's row order with the screen.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: "As of: " and today's date.
  • Step 2: the PDF downloads (A/R has an Export menu, no Print button).
  • Step 3: "As of " and today's date in the three-letter month form, not tomorrow's date.
  • Step 4: the PDF prints the on-screen order.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11533 (Story 3, Export to PDF and CSV)

  • What changes for existing users: “A/R's Print button becomes the Export menu; its PDF prints the on-screen order and the as-of date the user picked (today it can print the next day's date).”
  • S3-R4: “Each export states the as-of date the user picked: the PDF "As of Oct 15, 2026", the CSV "As of: Oct 15, 2026" (format: three-letter month, day, four-digit year).”
  • S3-R3: “The PDF and the CSV contain exactly the rows on screen for the chosen as-of date, customer or vendor and locations, in the on-screen sort, including a sort changed after an earlier export, without refreshing the page.”
